# West Coast KBP

> West Coast KBP is a construction platform for ADU (accessory dwelling unit)
> and residential construction in the Sacramento region of California:
> Roseville, Rocklin, Lincoln, Folsom, Granite Bay, El Dorado Hills, Citrus
> Heights, and nearby areas. Public service pages cover detached ADU, garage
> conversion, attached ADU, JADU, and ADU legalization review lanes.

The platform organizes construction work as controlled project objects with
visible scope, state, approvals, evidence, and next actions. The owner reviews
every commitment before it is made. The current site is a public portal: it
does not collect, submit, store, or track visitor information, and it makes no
pricing, schedule, permit, or feasibility claims. Property-specific questions
require individual review and official source verification.

## Pages

- [Home](https://westcoastkbp.com/): platform overview and the project-control
  approach.
- [Detached ADU](https://westcoastkbp.com/services/detached-adu): review context
  for a separate ADU structure.
- [Garage Conversion](https://westcoastkbp.com/services/garage-conversion):
  existing-condition and conversion review context.
- [Attached ADU](https://westcoastkbp.com/services/attached-adu): review context
  for the interface between existing and proposed work.
- [JADU](https://westcoastkbp.com/services/jadu): a distinct review lane with
  current official definitions left to source verification.
- [ADU Legalization](https://westcoastkbp.com/services/adu-legalization):
  evidence and mismatch review for an existing unit.
- [About](https://westcoastkbp.com/about): operating principles and an explicit
  list of business facts still pending owner input.
- [Compare](https://westcoastkbp.com/compare): a neutral comparison of ad hoc
  coordination and controlled review models.
- [Process](https://westcoastkbp.com/process): the six-stage controlled pathway
  from candidate request through evidence, OwnerReview, bounded action, and a
  reviewable record.
- [ADU FAQ](https://westcoastkbp.com/faq): answer-first orientation covering ADU
  terms, planning boundaries, service area, and the owner-controlled operating
  model.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Company name: West Coast KBP
- Category: ADU / residential construction (home and construction business)
- Service area: Sacramento region, California
- Website: https://westcoastkbp.com
- Property, permit, zoning, and buildability questions require official source
  verification.
